name: v0.9.0
body:
## Changelog
* 2099275a48ad209e2fb83e604753f481c6fab5c3 Add Contributors and Similar products
* 96dcd4ffd12dd94e706b4e323b9a252e1224572f Add a TODO item
* 30bd2491de91d4b5a3ffad3e1f2a946ef45652d0 Catch an error from qrencode.Encode()
* 690768bb6fd7dc42b26f4ee75be4fa3b56409e58 Create FUNDING.yml
* 2d481a157e4e07cb0aa54a9565b761b36347a29b Export tty library to github.com/fumiyas/go-tty
* 57df16967201092a056341db276ad8003147efa7 Makefile: Reduce default architectures
* 1c4a67bcf04f2686a7a7d93077ffe76a391596f1 Migrate to github.com/qpliu/qrencode-go/qrencode (close #1)
* 8720a996f0e2313d5187eaf96c2d383be1239e14 README: Add --input-encoding E to TODO list
* cbe3823d91df6c83d349a9447c1a462a777f4648 README: Add TODO list
* 207b5a80ad9f584a12829314a1a94d6455651c90 README: Add description to usage
* f270c14fcc8130205827148afb0980d087a649c2 README: Add similar products info
* b8670eb785dddceebdecd280b87bf13bc55f1fc6 README: Add use case
* 53dd31ec7e1a8e9f58aea2fc15d99ac51e72fee1 README: Mention `xterm -ti 340` for Sixel support
* 204a39bcd671e0dacbf657d3505301a3d160d61f README: Remove "alt" attribute from an image anchor
* 33cb4c59f2b1daec7e3d2d1a6f0b7f9aa4a9c4e7 README: Update copyright year to 2017
* 11ac161f8a6aee30b11c3b9f923eab7900621a2c Trivial changes
* d97b3a6e5044bae70908848d367da7bc9e16398f Trivial refactoring
* 334b0d0dced68c6638cf0db06e77c1103f2a894c Update copyright year 2015
* 971789debfb39bb7c65f4d730ffd3cec649749a7 build: Add .gitattributes to normalize line endings to LF
* 1d7d021ddae6488396a72d4afbb234eb6a507653 build: Add GitHub Actions CI workflow
* c590132f12ef59893dcd0baeeb3b8b5b5f45309a build: Introduce Go modules (go.mod/go.sum)
* abb3b563bbbb4af0c30e7198fa394d9eace83b3f build: Modernize Makefile (drop gox, add test/vet/fmt/clean)
* add598ba76e695d8b31f3e5105b043de2a062238 build: Require Go 1.25
* 9633cad8b37c3e3ff6078ff4b53abeb856aa02ab build: Update module dependencies
* 6df7b1beb0a86d19dc48c7a7dff63b6647e0ad9a build: Update transitive dependencies
* d88a9038a768f90ded55a17fac797d120ee60eff build: Upgrade deprecated GitHub actions/checkout@v4 version to v5
* 4ca869baa5cbbc4ad960d6932960acf6a3f2b0c5 ci: Add on.workflow_dispatch to trigger actions from GitHub web UI
* e850b084e9e4bfcc50cbe93ddd21185865c2176f ci: Add release workflow
* 88b8a9cc117ca71a407d6ff105db625828fa0a7e feat: Add --border / -b option
* b30015ab1a794cdcc98ce3db3df059765da4f316 feat: Add --ec-level / -l option
* 12b0d5173b8e698bae7c298e6df589bad6de753a feat: Add --output-format / -f option
* cb3dc691516e7280343740b778fb7d7f93bca3a4 feat: Add --scale / -s option
* de9c96f59298b7156925491a121e7836ec5da401 feat: Add unicode block output format
* 20b565fbadf7015d4dc54ff12d3fbfc70c5eb9f3 feat: Drop github.com/mgutz/ansi dependency
* 87435ee5f67e62efa428016ad41e16183a5539a7 feat: Internalize fumiyas/go-tty as internal/tty
* 3b0d3982cab285e850ad68635d26d352f1a5a98f feat: Switch QR encoder from qpliu/qrencode-go to rsc.io/qr
* 443d570e3aa67188e2a769704dda5832db27d88b fix: Match unicode output polarity to ansi/sixel on dark terminals
* 7de0cc765bc1861d7fd05068cbe46d6530b1fa06 fix: Write error messages to stderr instead of stdout
* 9bb1922fb7316e982200901a9fcabe01dce2fab4 refactor: Drop pre-Go 1.22 loop variable captures
* 71f9f06f5fd011159759d38672f9eebe69b6e673 refactor: Equalize horizontal/vertical quiet zone in ansi output
* 48ff4419a8a9cbab1e065d8a8dbe78a0cafa58f5 refactor: Move lib/ to internal/qrc/ and tidy import groups
* 16d67308485c5f4cc987720fdce39879937799b4 refactor: Replace io/ioutil with io.ReadAll (Go 1.16+)
* 57a17c3134ca70c3f687d4b5ba24f982f18bc39e refactor: Use bytes.Lines iterator (Go 1.24)
* 90627d32ef95e8a1490ac45eb3aab25672e0edfd refactor: Use range-over-int loops (Go 1.22)
* 7b2aa5b8cb1b0e3037edfaf088726c98f70f8aea sixel: Set the pixel aspect ratio explicitly
* 24d6285c9cd20878edc687e78e67140e765f0c69 style: Apply gofmt -s and staticcheck cleanups
* 1736cf0ae8b3b85151882d428a2643352ea04cbe style: Convert snake_case identifiers to camelCase
* e637e5ee24b691be7f771ddded6dfe12b307fe49 style: Replace interface{} with any
* 383b15fca14ead484ccdcf7fcfc960b3b1cc9cae tty: Define DA1_CLASS2, 3 and 5
